name: Kevin Dowling
bio: Kevin Dowling is an American film, television director and producer. He made directorial debut co-directing the film The Sum of Us starring Jack Thompson and Russell Crowe. In 1996, he directed the film Mojave Moon starring Danny Aiello, Anne Archer and Angelina Jolie. Since 1998, Dowling has directed for television, directing television films and television series namely Early Edition, Touched by an Angel, Gilmore Girls, Ed, Dead Like Me, One Tree Hill, Joan of Arcadia and a number of other series.
